title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Aparthotel
description: Aparthotel, a specialization of AccommodationEstablishment (estur:AccommodationEstablishment via TourismOrRelatedFacility, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology). NOTE: the source repository's README uses the misspelling 'AccomodationEstablishment' (single 'm'); the authoritative ontology spells it 'AccommodationEstablishment' (double 'm'), which is used throughout this candidate.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Aparthotel'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this accommodation establishment (estur:name).

registrationNumber.description: Property. Official tourism registration number of the establishment (estur:registrationNumber).

numberOfAccommodationUnits.description: Property. Number of accommodation units (rooms/apartments) (estur:numberOfAccommodationUnits). NOTE: the real open-data example this was translated from used the misspelled term 'numberOfAccomodationUnits' (single 'm'), which does not exist in the authoritative SEGITTUR ontology; the correctly spelled 'numberOfAccommodationUnits' is used here.

autonomousCheckIn.description: Property. Whether autonomous (unattended) check-in is available (estur:autonomousCheckIn).

hasPriceClass.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of the PriceClass controlled vocabulary (estur:hasPriceClass). Kept as a Relationship to the concept URI rather than an enumerated Property; see https://ontologia.segittur.es/turismo/kos/priceclass/ for the full vocabulary.

offersAdditionalAccommodationService.description: Relationship. Additional services offered (e.g. restaurant, pool), from the AccommodationService controlled vocabulary (estur:offersAdditionalAccommodationService). See https://ontologia.segittur.es/turismo/kos/accommodationservice/ for the full vocabulary.

typeOfAccommodationRate.description: Relationship. The types of rate offered (e.g. accommodation only, breakfast, half board, full board), from the AccommodationRateType controlled vocabulary (estur:typeOfAccommodationRate). NOTE: the real open-data example this was translated from used the term 'offersAccommodationRateType', which does not exist in the authoritative SEGITTUR ontology; the correct 'typeOfAccommodationRate' is used here. See https://ontologia.segittur.es/turismo/kos/accomodationratetype/ for the full vocabulary.

accommodationUnitCategory.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of the AccommodationUnitCategory controlled vocabulary (estur:accommodationUnitCategory).

offersAdditionalTouristOrRelatedFacility.description: Relationship. Additional tourist or related facility services offered (estur:offersAdditionalTouristOrRelatedFacility).

accommodationRating.description: Relationship. The Rating of this accommodation establishment (estur:accommodationRating).

hasLocation.description: Relationship. The Location of this accommodation establishment (estur:hasLocation).

hasContactPoint.description: Relationship. The ContactPoint of this accommodation establishment (estur:hasContactPoint).

hasDescription.description: Relationship. The Description of this accommodation establishment (estur:hasDescription).

hasBookingChannel.description: Relationship. The BookingChannel(s) through which this accommodation can be booked (estur:hasBookingChannel). NOTE: the source ontology's own domain declaration for hasBookingChannel (TourismOrganisation/TourismResource/TourismService) does not formally include AccommodationEstablishment's actual superclass chain (TourismOrRelatedFacility/Place/TourismEntity) — a domain/usage inconsistency in the ontology itself. This property is included here because the ontology's own documentation example uses it directly on a Hotel instance.

hasMultimedia.description: Relationship. Multimedia resources associated with this establishment (estur:hasMultimedia).

hasOpeningHours.description: Relationship. The opening hours of this establishment (estur:hasOpeningHours).
